chars.0592-3510-8508-7263:
Chose a model within 6" inches.
It suffers a wound with no save, and the caster gains an extra wound for the duration of the battle.
Can take it above maxiumums.
Can not be cast on undead or  possessed.

One Zombie that went out of action on the lasts hand to hand or shooting phase imediatly returns to battle.
Place the model within 6" of the necromancer. It can not be placed in direct hand to hand combat.
The necromancer causes fear for the duration of the battle.

Chose 1 model within 12" of the caster.
They must test strength.
If they fail they get an imediate check on the injury table.

One direwolf or zombie within 6" of the necromacer can move for free.
If they move into base to base contact with an enemy, it counts as having charged.

If a enemey hero is killed in battle, (an 11-16 on the serious injury chart) the necromancer may raise him as a zombie.

He is a henchmen that retains all equpiment and characteristics, but can not be armed with anything else, has no skills and can gain no more experience.
He is a normal zombie in all other respects.

modifiers.value: To promote a henchmen to hero, duplicate the group. Set one group to 1 promoted model and decrease the size of the remaining henchmen group by 1.
